senses.gloss:
गड् गड्, cl. 1. P. गडति, जगाड, गडितुम्,
to distil or drop, to run as a liquid; cl. 10.
P. गडयति, -यितुम्, to cover, hide.

गड, अस्, m. a kind of fish, the young of the
Ophiocephalus Lata; another species, Cyprinus Garra;
a kind of gold-fish; a screen, a covering, a fence;
a moat, a ditch; an impediment, an obstacle; a
country, part of Malwa, Garha or Gara Mandala.
—गड-देश-ज, अम्, n. or गड-लवण, अम्, n.
rock or fossil salt, especially that found in the district
of Saṃvara (= गड) in the province of Ajmere.
—गडोत्थ (˚ड-उत्˚), अम्, n. a kind of salt, = the
preceding.
गडक, अस्, m. a kind of fish, = गड.

गडयन्त गडयन्त, अस्, m. or गडयित्नु,
उस्, m. [cf. गर्दयित्नु], a cloud; [cf. गड् and
गडेर.]
गडि गडि, इस्, m. a young steer; a lazy ox.

गडु गडु, उस्, m. an excrescence on the
neck, goitre or bronchocele; a hump on the back;
a hump-backed or crooked man; a javelin, a spear;
an earth-worm; a water-pot; any superfluous ex-
crescence or continuation or addition (as to a poem).
—गडु-कण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a goitre.
—गडु-
शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having an excrescence on the head.

गडुक, अस्, m. a water-pot; a finger-ring; N. of
a man; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of this man.

गड्डुक गड्डुक or गड्डूक, अस्, m. a kind
of water-jar, a golden vase; [cf. गडु and गडुक.]
गडुर, अस्, आ, अम्, hump-backed, crooked, bent.
गडुल, अस्, ई, अम्, hump-backed, crooked.

गडेर गडेर, अस्, m. a cloud; [cf. गड-
यन्त.]

गडोल गडोल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. गड्),
raw sugar; a mouthful.

गड्डारिका गड्डारिका, f., N. of a river with
a very strong current, of which the source and course
are unknown; or (according to others) a single ewe
going in front of a flock of sheep.
गाडव गाडव, अस्, m. a cloud; [cf. गवेडु.]
